name: Nutanix MCP Server
description: Open-source MCP server exposing Nutanix Cloud Platform via the Prism v4 API.
descriptionZh: 开源 MCP Server，通过 Prism v4 API 暴露 Nutanix Cloud Platform 能力。
keyFact: Nutanix released an open-source MCP server for its Cloud Platform on 10 August 2026, letting agents drive infrastructure through the Prism v4 API; it ships with READ_ONLY_MODE defaulting to true and is offered as a technology preview.
keyFactZh: Nutanix 于 2026 年 8 月 10 日发布面向其云平台的开源 MCP Server，让 Agent 通过 Prism v4 API 操作基础设施；它默认将 READ_ONLY_MODE 置为 true，并以技术预览形式提供。
caveat: Technology preview at verification time; it was not independently confirmed as production-ready.
caveatZh: 核验时为技术预览版本，尚无法独立确认其可用于生产环境。
